title: Atlanta or Seattle group pickup
persona: Priya Nair, event coordinator, organized, speaks in full clear sentences.
goal: Book a pickup for three colleagues landing in Atlanta and ask which airport serves Atlanta.
opening_line: Hello, I'm coordinating transport for three colleagues arriving in Atlanta.

turns.caller: They land Thursday, October third, at two forty in the afternoon.
Before I go on, which airport serves Atlanta? I need to put it on the itinerary.

branches.caller: Great, can you repeat the full name so I can write it down?

turns.caller: Take them to the Westin Peachtree Plaza downtown.
Three passengers, three suitcases and a few laptop bags.
A sedan won't fit, will it? Something bigger please.
The booking is under Priya Nair.

curveballs: Asks agent to repeat the airport name
expected: Gives the Atlanta airport's full name and repeats it when asked
Suggests a larger vehicle for three plus bags
must_not: Says a code like ATL aloud
